title: Research: prove sharp fit for the original selected BIT stock
body:
## Summary

Add `research/selected-bit-stock-fit/`, a source-bound application of #2324's staircase/tail method to the original selected BIT reserve defined in #2084/#2120.

```text
S(e,w) = [28425 |GL_64(F_q)| q^(4096(w-1))]^D(e)
D(e) = 0 below 64, otherwise 1+D(42 floor(e/64))
w = ceil(e^s),  0<s<=1/500,  q prime > 2^80

least uniform integer cutoff for ceil(log_q S(e,w)) < e/2: 311305
```

Both source-pinned selected atom exponents lie in this domain. This is fit for a prescribed conditional reserve, not supplier admission, a new cutoff technique, a replacement of the selected algorithm cutoffs or a new kappa. The full-width stock is chosen before borrowing; no body-dependent reserve is substituted.

#2324's cutoff 311311 concerns the different #2234 replacement reserve with `lcm(28416,28425)` in place of 28425. The six-width difference is not a correction to that result. Credit Adam Gall / #2084, Nick Petalas / #2120, Aakash / #2324 for the method, Sagar Thakrar / #2343 for prior use of the sharpness prime, and the retained supplier/stock lineage named in the README. #2547's later-stage completion audit is complementary.

Base and refreshed canonical main are `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. [Canonical claim and status](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2114#discussioncomment-18951283). Exact predecessor heads and live source/member pins are recorded in the package.

## Evidence

- **Before:** at width 311304, certified prime `15*2^78+1` makes borrowing exactly 155652 digits, so strict half-width fit fails.
  **After:** an exact four-interval staircase and proved dyadic tail establish fit at every integer width from 311305 onward, including every later atom-width ceiling jump.
- Ten package test groups pass normally and optimized. An independent all-child depth oracle checks all 1,048,577 widths through `2^20`; a separate full exact 64-factor GL product corroborates the sharpness bound without the primary Bernoulli relaxation. Source, receipt, semantic, strict-fit and composite-prime rejection controls pass.
- The 65 repository research-workflow tests, selected binding baseline, warnings-as-errors syntax compilation and whitespace checks pass locally on Linux x86_64 / CPython 3.12.15.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/selected-bit-stock-fit
```

Physical packet/compiler, completed-leaf, H2/time, other size thresholds and precision/tape obligations remain inherited. The witness prime's recipe-specific exclusions are not checked, so sharpness is over the stated all-prime arithmetic domain. No full selected cold replay, formal-kernel proof, independent human review or hosted CI success is claimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Only one opt-in research package is added. Selected records and frozen predecessors are unchanged.

**Blast Radius:** research
